before.en: Artificial-intelligence data centres could support electricity grids by postponing computing, but online services limit how much work operators can allow to wait. Here we connect explicit workload permissions to response capacity, repeated delivery, photovoltaic integration and participation costs. A production resource-time audit identifies low-priority training and offline inference as a candidate pool, without equating priority with permission. With 5–20% of work eligible, independently tested single-event offers are 2.95–11.80 kW for modelled operating peaks of 190–200 kW. Repeated-call failures depend on both recovery control and service constraints. Preserving the power ceiling for every overlapping recovery window increased eight-hour programme success at 10% eligibility from 252/300 to 294/300 at the same request. A separate development selection and independent test qualified full four-hour offers and eight-hour offers at 75% of the single-event request across the five workload scenarios. Smaller commitments concentrate fixed participation costs on fewer kilowatts. Dependable flexibility therefore requires a declared workload permission, recovery policy and call schedule, together with compensation evaluated for that qualified offer.
before.zh: 人工智能数据中心可以通过推迟计算支持电网，但在线服务限制了运营者能够允许等待的工作量。本文将明确的工作延期权限与响应容量、重复交付、光伏接入和参与成本联系起来。生产资源时间审计将低优先级训练与离线推理识别为候选工作池，但不把低优先级等同于参与许可。在允许 5–20% 工作延后的情景中，独立检验的单次事件承诺为 2.95–11.80 kW，对应模型运行峰值 190–200 kW。重复调用失败同时取决于恢复控制和服务约束。在 10% 工作资格下，为每个重叠恢复窗口保留功率上限，使同一八小时响应请求的整组成功次数从 252/300 提高至 294/300。另行开展的开发选值与独立检验，在全部五档工作情景中支持四小时全额承诺，以及单次事件请求 75% 的八小时承诺。较小承诺使固定参与成本分摊到更少的千瓦上。因此，可靠灵活性需要明确工作延期权限、恢复策略与调用安排，并针对通过资格检验的承诺评估补偿。

after.en: Artificial-intelligence data centres could support electricity grids by postponing computing, but operators must choose commitments that preserve service through repeated calls. Here we link workload permissions to independently tested response offers and their participation costs. A production resource-time audit informs scenarios with 5–20% of work eligible, which support single-event offers of 2.95–11.80 kW for modelled operating peaks of 190–200 kW. Using a controller that enforces every recovery obligation, we then vary offered utilisation, deadlines and call schedules. At 10% eligibility, requiring zero deadline loss instead of a 1% allowance reduces the selected eight-hour repeated offer from 4.42 to 2.95 kW in the reference comparison. With submission timing from eight production weeks, these requests succeed in 63/80 and 80/80 synthetic realisations, respectively. Increasing flexible GPU allocation does not restore the larger request. Fixed site fees explain about 95% of the original four-hour participation threshold, yet removing them leaves distinct operating costs for qualified duration products. The resulting evidence supports choosing a service standard and call commitment together, then pricing that specific offer; neither workload eligibility nor a low access cost is sufficient.
after.zh: 人工智能数据中心可以通过推迟计算为电网提供支持，但运营者必须选择能够在重复调用中维持任务服务的响应承诺。本文将工作参与许可与独立检验的响应报价及其参与成本连接起来。生产资源时间审计为 5–20% 工作可延后的情景提供依据；这些情景在约 190–200 kW 的模型运行峰值下，支持 2.95–11.80 kW 的单次响应报价。随后，我们使用执行全部恢复义务的控制器，改变工作供给利用率、期限和调用安排。在 10% 工作可延后的参考比较中，将期限违约容忍度从 1% 收紧到零，使选出的八小时重复响应承诺由 4.42 降至 2.95 kW。采用八个生产周的提交时序后，两档请求分别在 63/80 和 80/80 次合成实现中成功；增加灵活工作池的 GPU 分配未能恢复较大请求的表现。固定场站费用解释了原四小时参与门槛的约 95%，但取消这一费用后，合格时长产品的运行成本仍然不同。因此，应共同选择任务服务标准和调用承诺，再为该具体报价定价；仅有工作参与许可或较低接入费用都不足以确定可行的参与方案。

before.en: Here we assess data-centre power commitments across declared workload compositions, following each configuration through service qualification, repeated dispatch, PV integration and participation costs. We audit a production execution summary and construct scenarios in which 5%, 10% or 20% of offered work may wait. Higher-share comparisons at 40% and 60% expose the extra participation and business-composition assumptions needed for larger flexibility. AIDRBench combines trace-informed job shapes with four-GPU power measurements and a modelled community electricity system. Full-information schedules quantify planning potential, while independent causal-controller tests assess delivery. A recovery intervention then distinguishes failures caused by a controller limitation from remaining deadline pressure, and a frozen development-to-confirmation procedure tests revised repeated offers. The analysis connects workload permission to an independently tested operating choice and its downstream cost.
before.zh: 本文针对明确声明的工作构成评估数据中心功率承诺，并将每档配置贯穿服务资格检验、重复调用、光伏接入和参与成本分析。我们审计生产执行汇总，构建允许 5%、10% 或 20% 到达工作等待的情景。40% 和 60% 的较高比例比较揭示了获取更大灵活性所需的额外参与许可与业务构成假设。AIDRBench 将基于轨迹的作业形态、四 GPU 功率测量和社区电力系统模型结合起来。完整信息调度用于量化规划潜力，独立的因果控制器检验用于评估实际交付。随后通过恢复控制干预，将控制器局限导致的失败与剩余的期限压力区分开，并通过冻结的开发选值—确认流程检验调整后的重复承诺。这样，工作延期权限便与经过独立检验的运行选择及其后续成本相连接。

after.en: Here we assess which computing commitments an operator can support, and at what conditional cost. A production execution audit informs scenarios with 5%, 10% or 20% of work permitted to wait; 40% and 60% comparisons expose the additional participation and business-composition assumptions needed for larger flexibility. AIDRBench combines trace-informed jobs, four-GPU power measurements and a modelled community electricity system. We distinguish full-information planning from independent causal-controller tests, then examine corrected recovery control under changed utilisation, deadlines and call histories. A separate timing test preserves the order of submissions from eight production weeks.<sup>28</sup> Finally, complete operating ledgers separate the costs of service delivery from fixed access fees and compare compensation for qualified duration products. These steps turn a workload permission into a testable choice of service standard, capacity and call arrangement.
after.zh: 本文研究运营者能够支持哪些计算负荷响应承诺，以及这些承诺在给定假设下需要多少补偿。生产执行记录审计为 5%、10% 或 20% 工作获准等待的情景提供依据；40% 和 60% 对照则揭示更大灵活性需要额外的参与和业务结构假设。AIDRBench 将轨迹启发的作业、四 GPU 功率测量与社区电力模型结合起来。我们区分完整未来信息下的规划与因果控制器的独立检验，再用修正后的恢复控制，研究利用率、期限和调用历史变化。另一个时序检验保留了八个生产周的提交顺序。<sup>28</sup> 最后，完整运行账本将服务交付成本与固定接入费用分开，比较合格时长产品需要的补偿。这些步骤将工作参与许可转化为可以检验的服务标准、容量和调用安排选择。

before.zh: ### 恢复控制改变了能够通过检验的重复承诺

after.en: ### Service requirements and workload timing change the repeated commitment
after.zh: ### 任务服务要求与工作时序改变可重复调用的承诺

before.en: The first repeated-call comparison showed why a single-event result cannot simply be reused. At 10% eligibility and a 5.90-kW request, four eight-hour calls with twelve-hour gaps succeeded in 256/300 original confirmation scenarios, compared with 297/300 when the four calls ran separately at the same clock times. The paired difference was −13.7 percentage points (95% interval, −17.7 to −9.7). However, a failure of the electrical recovery criterion is not evidence of lost computing work. Inspection revealed that the original controller retained only one binding recovery window. When windows overlapped, that window did not always impose the tightest allowable power ceiling (Fig. 3b).
before.zh: 首次重复调用比较说明，单次事件结果不能直接复用。在 10% 工作资格和 5.90 kW 请求下，四次八小时调用、调用间隔十二小时，在原确认集上的整组成功次数为 256/300；若在相同钟点分别运行这四次调用，则为 297/300。配对差异为 −13.7 个百分点（95% 区间，−17.7 至 −9.7）。但电力恢复指标失败并不等于计算工作丢失。检查发现，原控制器只保留一个起约束作用的恢复窗口；多个窗口重叠时，这个窗口不一定给出最严格的允许功率上限（图 3b）。

after.en: We next tested repeated commitments after correcting the controller to enforce every overlapping recovery window. The earlier repair also benefited a greedy policy, so it established an implementation requirement rather than an MPC-specific advantage (Supplementary Fig. 3a; Supplementary Tables 10–12). The new comparison held eligibility at 10% and varied offered utilisation from 50% to 80%, with reference or halved deadline slack and selected GPU-allocation controls. Four eight-hour calls were tested at 16- or 24-h start spacing. Anchoring the final call at the same randomly chosen hour allowed a matched single-call check while retaining different preceding call histories.
after.zh: 接下来，我们在控制器已经能够执行全部重叠恢复窗口约束的前提下，检验重复响应承诺。此前的修复同样改善了贪心策略，因而说明的是实现必须满足的要求，不能证明 MPC 独有的优势（补充图 3a；补充表 10–12）。新比较固定 10% 的工作可延后，将工作供给利用率设为 50–80%，采用参考期限或减半的期限余量，并加入指定的 GPU 分配对照。四次八小时调用的开始间隔为 16 或 24 h。将最后一次调用固定在相同的随机时刻，可以在保留不同先前调用历史的同时，与单独调用进行配对核对。

before.en: We therefore retained every observed call’s recovery ceiling while keeping the request, workload, MPC policy and success criteria fixed. On 300 new paired scenarios, eight-hour programme success at 10% eligibility increased from 252/300 to 294/300: 14.0 percentage points (95% paired interval, 10.3 to 18.0; Fig. 3a). All 42 rescued scenarios originally failed only window peak relief; no new scenario exceeded the deadline-miss criterion. The same guards around a greedy proposal also achieved 294/300, so the gain was not specific to MPC. Tighter recovery still has a service cost: with eight-hour gaps, full-request deadline failures increased from 7/100 to 33/100 in development (Supplementary Fig. 3; Supplementary Table 11).
before.zh: 因此，我们为每次已观察到的调用保留恢复功率上限，同时保持请求、工作负载、MPC 策略和成功标准不变。在 300 个新的配对情景中，10% 工作资格下的八小时整组成功次数从 252/300 增至 294/300，即提高 14.0 个百分点（95% 配对区间，10.3 至 18.0；图 3a）。挽救的 42 个情景原先均仅因窗口峰值减负不足而失败，没有新增情景超过错过期限比例标准。同样的约束用于贪心提议策略也达到 294/300，说明收益并非 MPC 特有。但更严格恢复仍有服务代价：在八小时间隔的开发比较中，全额请求的期限失败从 7/100 增至 33/100（补充图 3；补充表 11）。

after.en: The supported offer depended on the task-service requirement. At 65% offered utilisation and reference deadlines, the development-selected request for 16-h start spacing was 4.42 kW with at most 1% missed eligible work, but 2.95 kW with zero missed work; independent confirmation yielded 299/300 and 300/300 successes, respectively (Fig. 3a). Across the full structural grid, all 26 positive endpoint-specific selections passed confirmation; eight combinations selected no candidate (Supplementary Table 14). Retrospective zero-miss scoring left the earlier 30 selected offers’ success counts unchanged, but reduced the unselected full eight-hour comparison at 10% eligibility from 294/300 to 288/300, below the probability-bound qualification rule (Supplementary Table 13). Zero loss therefore changes some operating choices, rather than imposing a universal derating.
after.zh: 可支持的报价取决于任务服务要求。在 65% 工作供给利用率和参考期限下，开始间隔 16 h 的方案若允许最多 1% 的可参与工作期限违约，开发集选出的请求为 4.42 kW；若要求零期限违约，则为 2.95 kW。两者在独立确认中分别成功 299/300 和 300/300 次（图 3a）。在完整结构网格中，按不同服务终点选出的 26 个正容量候选全部通过确认，另外八个组合没有选出候选（补充表 14）。对原有结果进行零违约重评分时，先前 30 个已选报价的成功计数没有改变；但 10% 情景中未被选中的全额八小时对照由 294/300 降至 288/300，未达到概率下界判定规则（补充表 13）。因此，零损失要求会改变部分运营选择，并不对应统一的容量折减比例。

after.en: At the unchanged 5.90-kW request, immediate reducible power was insufficient in 203/300 low-utilisation programmes with 16-h spacing, versus 2/300 at 80% utilisation. Halving deadline slack instead caused more than 1% of work to miss its deadline in all 300 programmes at each utilisation (Fig. 3b). Doubling flexible GPU allocation from 10% to 20% did not restore that full request. Yet the final call’s electrical outcome was identical to its same-clock isolated counterpart in every structural comparison (Supplementary Fig. 3b). These results distinguish a necessary instantaneous supply limit from episode-wide service pressure; they do not show that accumulated work inevitably degrades the next electrical response. Nor did longer spacing consistently improve the selected offer, because preceding calls also moved to different hours.
after.zh: 在不变的 5.90 kW 请求下，16 h 开始间隔的低利用率方案有 203/300 次因当前可削减功率不足而受限，而 80% 利用率下仅为 2/300 次。将期限余量减半后，每档利用率的全部 300 次方案都出现了超过 1% 的工作期限违约（图 3b）。把灵活工作池的 GPU 分配从 10% 加倍到 20%，未能恢复该全额请求。然而，所有结构对照中，最后一次调用的电力侧结果都与相同时刻的孤立调用完全相同（补充图 3b）。这些结果区分了瞬时可供功率这一必要限制与整个运行阶段的任务服务压力，不能证明积累的工作必然削弱下一次电力响应。更长的开始间隔也未持续提高选出的报价，因为先前调用同时移动到了不同小时。

after.en: The larger offer was also sensitive to temporal structure. Applying the frozen 4.42-kW request to chronologically ordered submissions from eight production weeks gave 63/80 successful synthetic realisations, compared with 76/80 after permuting whole hourly blocks within each week. The 2.95-kW zero-miss request succeeded in all 80 realisations under either ordering (Fig. 3c). Doubling GPU allocation retained 63/80 at the larger chronological request. Permutation was not uniformly beneficial at other tested requests (Supplementary Table 16). These eight-week comparisons preserve observed submission timing while retaining synthetic work sizes and deadlines; they test transfer under a changed structure, not production service-level compliance.
after.zh: 较大报价还对时间结构敏感。将冻结的 4.42 kW 请求应用于八个生产周按原序排列的提交时序，在 80 次合成实现中成功 63 次；将各周内的完整小时块置乱后，成功 76 次。2.95 kW 的零违约请求在两种顺序下均为 80/80 成功（图 3c）。GPU 分配加倍后，较大请求在原序下仍为 63/80。对于其他测试请求，置乱并非总能改善结果（补充表 16）。这一八周比较保留真实提交时序，但工作量和期限仍由合成规则给定；它检验的是结构改变后的适用性，不是生产服务等级协议的履约证明。

before.en: To identify usable programmes, we selected capacities on 100 development scenarios before testing them on the new confirmation set. The controller with per-call recovery qualified full four-hour offers with eight-hour gaps and 75% eight-hour offers with gaps of eight, twelve or sixteen hours in all five workload configurations (299–300/300 successes; Supplementary Table 10). At 10% eligibility, these choices provide 5.90 and 4.42 kW, respectively (Fig. 3c). The full eight-hour request also passed the prespecified confirmation comparison, but had failed development selection; it was not promoted retrospectively. The original controller selected an eight-hour candidate only at the sixteen-hour gap. These are qualified points on the tested grid, not maximum capacities or evidence that every programme needs a 25% reduction. Changing the gap also changes subsequent clock times.
before.zh: 为识别可用的调用安排，我们先在 100 个开发情景上选择容量，再用新的确认集检验。逐次保留恢复约束的控制器，在全部五档工作配置中均支持四小时调用、八小时间隔的全额承诺，以及八小时调用、八/十二/十六小时间隔的 75% 承诺（整组成功次数 299–300/300；补充表 10）。在 10% 工作资格下，对应承诺分别为 5.90 和 4.42 kW（图 3c）。八小时全额请求也通过了预设确认比较，但它此前未通过开发选值，因此没有被事后提升为选定承诺。原控制器仅在十六小时间隔下选出了八小时候选。这些是所测网格中通过检验的选择，并非最大容量，也不说明所有调用安排都必须降额 25%。改变间隔也会改变后续调用的钟点。

before.zh: ### 工作资格改变光伏承载与本地利用

after.en: ### PV hosting gains need not imply substantial utilisation gains
after.zh: ### 光伏接纳容量增加不等于利用率显著提高

before.en: With the 576-GPU installation fixed, flexibility increased all-scenario PV hosting by 2.82, 5.40 and 10.36 kW at 5%, 10% and 20% eligibility without BESS. At 10%, the gain with BESS was 5.22 kW (Fig. 4a; Supplementary Table 6). These capacities were feasible across all 100 paired confirmation scenarios under at most 5% curtailment and zero deadline misses. Each configuration used its own power model and the same 1,100-kW PCC rating, enabling paired comparisons at a fixed GPU installation.
before.zh: 固定 576 张 GPU 时，在无储能条件下，5%、10%、20% 资格的灵活性分别使全情景光伏承载增加 2.82、5.40、10.36 kW。10% 资格配储能时增加 5.22 kW（图 4a；补充表 6）。这些容量在全部 100 个配对确认情景中均满足弃光不超过 5% 且截止时间损失为零。各配置使用自身功率模型及共同的 1,100 kW PCC 限制，在固定 GPU 设施下进行配对比较。

after.en: At the fixed 576-GPU installation, flexibility increased all-scenario PV hosting by 2.82, 5.40 and 10.36 kW at 5%, 10% and 20% eligibility without BESS (Fig. 4a; Supplementary Table 6). In the 10% case, however, a fixed 500-kW PV installation gained only 0.0057 percentage points of local utilisation (95% paired interval, 0.0019–0.0106; Fig. 4b). Additional installed capacity and improved use of an existing installation are therefore distinct benefits.
after.zh: 在固定 576 个 GPU 的安装规模下，无电池储能时，5%、10% 和 20% 工作可延后分别使全情景光伏接纳边界增加 2.82、5.40 和 10.36 kW（图 4a；补充表 6）。但在 10% 情景中，对固定 500 kW 光伏装机的本地利用率，增益仅为 0.0057 个百分点（95% 配对区间为 0.0019–0.0106；图 4b）。因此，增加可安装容量与提高既有装机利用程度是不同的收益。

before.en: For a fixed 500-kW PV installation, the 10% case increased local utilisation by only 0.0057 percentage points without BESS (95% paired interval, 0.0019–0.0106). With BESS, the reported difference was below 0.0001 percentage points and was not resolved at the configured mixed-integer optimisation precision (Fig. 4b). Small signed storage contrasts are retained in the data; sampling intervals do not include optimisation error. This energy-fraction metric answers a different question from additional installed kilowatts. Storage and flexible work therefore require evaluation within the same local model.
before.zh: 对于固定 500 kW 光伏装置，10% 资格在无储能时使本地利用率仅提高 0.0057 个百分点（95% 配对区间 0.0019–0.0106）。有储能时，报告差异小于 0.0001 个百分点，未达到当前混合整数求解精度下可分辨的水平（图 4b）。源数据保留有储能时的微小正负差异；抽样区间不包含优化误差。这一电量比例指标与新增安装千瓦回答不同问题，储能与灵活工作因此需要在同一本地模型中联合评估。

after.en: With BESS, the 10% hosting gain was 5.22 kW and the utilisation contrast was unresolved at the configured mixed-integer optimisation precision. Small signed storage contrasts remain in Source Data; sampling intervals exclude optimisation error. All renewable results used full future information, zero missed work and separately optimised schedules. They establish conditional planning benefits rather than outcomes demonstrated by the causal response controller.
after.zh: 有电池储能时，10% 情景的接纳容量增益为 5.22 kW，而利用率差异在所设混合整数优化精度下无法辨明。源数据保留了这些很小的有符号储能差值；抽样区间不包含优化误差。全部可再生能源结果均采用完整未来信息、零工作期限违约和单独优化的调度。因此，它们体现条件性的规划收益，尚不是因果响应控制器已实现的效果。

before.en: ### Low eligibility concentrates fixed participation costs on fewer offered kilowatts
before.zh: ### 低资格使固定参与成本集中于更少承诺千瓦

after.en: ### Access fees and operating costs affect different participation decisions
after.zh: ### 接入费用与运行成本影响不同的参与决策

before.en: We next priced each independently qualified single-event offer using its own response and no-response trajectories through recovery. Annual compensation was the payment per offered kilowatt required to make the fifth percentile of net value non-negative under specified energy, waiting and participation costs. Natural slack, reserved headroom and assumed displaced-value exposure describe different costs of providing the same electrical offer (Fig. 6). They are scenarios for screening participation, not measured operator profits.
before.zh: 随后用各自贯穿恢复期的响应与无响应轨迹，为每个独立合格的单次承诺核算价格。年度补偿为在指定能耗、等待和参与成本下，使净值第 5 百分位不为负所需的每承诺千瓦费用。自然空闲、预留容量与假定挤占价值暴露，描述同一电气承诺的不同供给成本（图 6）。它们用于参与筛选，不是实测运营商利润。

after.en: We priced each qualified offer from its complete response and recovery ledger. The payment threshold makes the fifth percentile of annual net value non-negative at stated prices and a proportional 1-MW accounting scale. In the original 10% eligibility, four-hour single-event case, US$819.90 of the US$863.26 per offered kW-year threshold came from the assumed US$25,000 annual site fee: about 95% (Fig. 6a). The strong low-eligibility penalty was therefore primarily fixed-cost allocation. Removing that fee left US$43.36 per kW-year in net operating exposure; reserve and displaced-value assumptions remain separate sensitivities (Supplementary Tables 7 and 9).
after.zh: 我们根据每个合格报价的完整响应及恢复账本定价。参与门槛是在指定价格与按比例折算的 1 MW 核算规模下，使年度净值第五百分位不低于零的补偿。在原有 10% 工作可延后、四小时单次响应情景中，每报价千瓦每年 863.26 美元的门槛里，有 819.90 美元来自假设的每年 25,000 美元固定场站费用，占约 95%（图 6a）。因此，低参与比例下较高的单位门槛主要来自固定成本分摊。取消这一费用后，净运行成本门槛为每千瓦每年 43.36 美元；备用容量与假定被挤占业务价值另作敏感性分析（补充表 7、9）。

before.en: At a proportional 1-MW accounting scale, 50 independent four-hour calls per year and a US$25,000 annual site charge, slack-participation thresholds were US$1653.07, 863.26 and 468.04 per offered kW-year at 5%, 10% and 20% eligibility. For 10%, reserved headroom raised the threshold to US$979.40, and assumed displaced value raised it to US$1003.51 (Fig. 6a; Supplementary Table 7). The 1-MW conversion scales the paired ledger and offered power; it does not certify a 1-MW installation.
before.zh: 在按比例换算的 1 MW 会计尺度、每年 50 个独立四小时调用及 25,000 美元站点年费下，5%、10%、20% 资格的自然空闲参与门槛分别为每承诺 kW 每年 1653.07、863.26、468.04 美元。10% 资格下，预留容量使门槛升至 979.40 美元，假定挤占价值使其升至 1003.51 美元（图 6a；补充表 7）。1 MW 换算按比例缩放配对账本与承诺功率，不认证 1 MW 设施。

after.en: Zero or shared fees did not eliminate the operating distinction between the new qualified products. At reference utilisation and deadlines, the zero-miss four-hour programme offered 4.42 kW, whereas both eight-hour programmes offered 2.95 kW. With no fixed fee, their thresholds were US$174.54, 321.09 and 401.72 per offered accounting kW-year for four-hour/16-h, eight-hour/16-h and eight-hour/24-h duration/start-spacing combinations, respectively (Fig. 6b,c; Supplementary Table 17). All used twelve independent four-call series per year. These differences reflect complete-series operating exposure and selected capacity, rather than a site charge divided by a smaller offer.
after.zh: 零固定费用或共享费用并未消除新合格产品之间的运行差异。在参考利用率和期限下，零违约四小时方案报价为 4.42 kW，两种八小时方案均为 2.95 kW。取消固定费用后，对于“时长/开始间隔”为四小时/16 h、八小时/16 h 和八小时/24 h 的三个组合，门槛依次为每核算报价千瓦每年 174.54、321.09 和 401.72 美元（图 6b,c；补充表 17）。三者均按每年十二组相互独立的四次调用核算。这些差异来自完整调用组的运行负担与选定容量，而非固定场站费用除以较小报价。

before.en: The low-share cases deliver less total power while sharing the same site charge. This fixed-cost denominator explains why a smaller eligible pool can require a higher payment per offered kilowatt even though less work is postponed. At 10%, extending calls from four to eight hours changed the slack threshold from US$863.26 to US$949.73 per kW-year at the same selected power (Fig. 6b). Duration therefore changes the cost of the service even when the finite candidate grid selects the same capacity.
before.zh: 低比例情景提供的总功率较少，却承担相同站点费用。这一固定成本分母解释了为何合格池较小时，即使推迟工作较少，每承诺千瓦仍可能需要更高补偿。10% 资格下，承诺功率不变，将调用从四小时延长到八小时，使自然空闲门槛从每 kW 每年 863.26 变为 949.73 美元（图 6b）。因此，即使有限网格选出相同容量，时长仍会改变服务成本。

after.en: A common site fee changes whether to enter, but cancels when comparing the annual net values of two participating options. At an illustrative equal capacity price of US$250 per kW-year and no site fee, the reference zero-miss four-hour programme had a fifth-percentile annual net value of US$1,726; the eight-hour programme at the same 16-h spacing had −US$1,084 (Supplementary Fig. 5c). For the latter to match the former conditional on participation, its capacity price must equal 1.5 times the four-hour price plus US$59.28 per kW-year. The additional requirement to outperform opting out defines the full price boundary (Fig. 6d). Sharing the original site fee among five or ten resources lowers access costs, but does not establish portfolio reliability or remove this operating tradeoff.
after.zh: 共同的场站费用会改变是否进入市场，但在比较两个参与方案的年度净值时会相互抵消。示例中，若两种产品的容量价格均为每千瓦每年 250 美元且无固定场站费用，参考零违约四小时方案的年度净值第五百分位为 1,726 美元；同为 16 h 开始间隔的八小时方案则为 −1,084 美元（补充图 5c）。在选择参与的条件下，后者要达到前者的净值，其容量价格必须等于四小时价格的 1.5 倍，再加每千瓦每年 59.28 美元；同时优于不参与的要求构成完整价格边界（图 6d）。将原场站费用分摊给五个或十个资源会降低接入成本，但并不证明组合可靠性，也不会消除这一运行取舍。

before.en: At 10% eligibility, changing the waiting price from zero to twice its reference value moved the four-hour slack threshold from US$810.73 to US$915.95 per kW-year. Fixed site charges, assumed displaced values, missed-work prices and reserve life were also varied (Supplementary Fig. 5; Supplementary Table 9). The reserve-life calculation is an accounting sensitivity, not a measurement of GPU ageing or a substitute for procurement data.
before.zh: 10% 资格下，将等待价格从零调至参考值的两倍，四小时自然空闲门槛由每 kW 每年 810.73 美元变为 915.95 美元。另改变站点固定费、假定挤占价值、未完成工作价格与预留寿命（补充图 5；补充表 9）。预留寿命计算属于会计敏感性，不是 GPU 老化测量，也不能替代采购数据。

after.en: These are conditional participation screens. All confirmation trajectories, including failures, enter the accounts; waiting and missed-work prices are varied separately from access fees (Supplementary Fig. 5). Contract-specific non-performance penalties, checkpoint costs and actual hardware ageing remain unpriced. Independent annual series do not reproduce a continuously operating year, and lower calculated cost cannot make an unqualified request an offerable product.
after.zh: 这些结果是条件性参与筛选。核算保留全部确认轨迹，包括失败轨迹；等待与期限违约工作的价格分别于接入费用之外进行变化（补充图 5）。合同规定的不履约罚款、检查点成本与真实硬件老化尚未定价。年度核算中的独立调用组不等于连续运行的一年，较低的计算成本也不能使未通过资格检验的请求成为可报价产品。

before.en: The selected repeated offers connect recovery requirements to participation costs (Fig. 6c). At 10% eligibility, the full 5.90-kW four-hour programme requires US$984 per offered accounting kW-year; the qualified 4.42-kW eight-hour programmes require US$1349–1408 under the same reference prices. All use twelve independent four-call series per year. Longer service and a smaller offer increase the required payment through waiting exposure and fixed-cost allocation. Complete ledgers count every hour once and retain failed trajectories. Non-performance penalties remain unpriced, and independent series do not represent a continuously operating year.
before.zh: 选出的重复承诺将恢复要求与参与成本联系起来（图 6c）。在 10% 工作资格下，四小时全额 5.90 kW 调用安排需要每个报价核算千瓦每年 984 美元；在相同参考价格下，通过检验的八小时 4.42 kW 安排需要 1349–1408 美元。各安排均按每年十二组相互独立、每组四次调用核算。更长服务和较小承诺通过等待暴露及固定成本分摊提高所需补偿。完整账本对每小时只计一次，并保留失败轨迹。合同违约罚款仍未定价，独立序列也不等于连续运行的一整年。

before.en: Repeated operation makes recovery policy part of the commitment. The intervention separates two causes that an aggregate failure rate would obscure: incomplete enforcement of overlapping electrical obligations and deadline pressure under tighter recovery control. Correcting the first is an implementation repair, not a new physical limit. Independent selection and confirmation then establish feasible operating choices rather than attributing every failure to compute debt. This complements trace-based estimates of eligible and dependable workload power,<sup>19</sup> by following causal execution, service failures and accounting through a specified multi-call programme. The tested 75% candidates do not establish a universal derating rule, and the model does not prove optimality.
before.zh: 重复运行使恢复策略成为承诺的一部分。干预区分了总失败率会掩盖的两种原因：重叠电力义务没有被完整执行，以及更严格恢复控制下的作业期限压力。纠正前者是实现修正，并非发现了新的物理极限。随后通过独立选值和确认建立可行运行选择，而不是将所有失败都归因于计算债务。这通过追踪特定多次调用安排中的因果执行、服务失败和完整账目，补充了基于轨迹估计合资格工作功率及可靠功率的研究。<sup>19</sup> 所测 75% 候选不构成普适降额规则，模型也没有证明最优性。

after.en: The additional operating insight concerns which obligation should change when a request fails. Under corrected recovery control, low offered utilisation can leave insufficient immediate reducible power, while tight deadlines can make task completion the binding service condition. Extra GPU allocation alone did not restore the full request in those deadline controls. Requiring zero deadline loss changed the selected reference eight-hour offer and improved its descriptive transfer to observed production timing. This complements prior distinctions between eligible and dependable workload power<sup>19</sup> by testing the service standard attached to a repeated offer. It does not establish a new optimal controller or a universal physical capacity law.
after.zh: 新增的运营认识在于：请求失败时，应该调整哪一项义务。在修正后的恢复控制下，较低工作供给利用率可能意味着当前可削减功率不足，而紧期限可能使任务完成成为约束服务的主要条件。仅增加 GPU 分配未能在这些期限对照中恢复全额请求。要求零期限违约改变了参考八小时方案选出的报价，并改善了它在真实生产时序下的描述性迁移表现。这通过检验重复报价所附带的服务标准，补充了既有研究对可参与工作功率与可靠减负的区分。<sup>19</sup> 它并不确立新的最优控制器或普适的物理容量规律。

before.en: Lower eligibility concentrates fixed site costs on a smaller offer. Reserved headroom and hypothetical displaced value can add further charges, while longer calls increase waiting exposure. The complete ledgers make these mechanisms recalculable at other prices. They do not establish actual GPU wear, operator revenue loss or profitability, and a low conditional price cannot compensate for an unqualified repeated programme. Technical qualification remains a prerequisite for interpreting a participation threshold as an offerable option.
before.zh: 较低资格使固定站点成本集中于更小承诺。预留容量和假定挤占价值可增加收费，较长调用则增加等待暴露。完整账本使这些机制可在其他价格下重新计算，但不能证明真实 GPU 磨损、运营商收入损失或盈利；较低条件价格也不能弥补重复方案不合格。将参与门槛解释为可报价选项之前，技术资格仍是前提。

after.en: The economic distinction is equally consequential. Fixed access fees largely explained the original unit-cost penalty at low eligibility, so that penalty should not be presented as a new operational mechanism. Once access is free or shared, complete-ledger costs still distinguish duration products and their required tariffs. Operators should therefore compare qualified annual net values, including the option not to participate, rather than rank services solely by a threshold per offered kilowatt. Waiting prices and loss valuations remain assumptions; the calculation identifies what compensation would be required under them, not whether a real operator will accept it.
after.zh: 经济上的区分同样影响决策。固定接入费用解释了原分析中低参与比例的多数单位成本惩罚，因此不应把这种分摊关系写成新的运行机制。接入免费或共享后，完整账本的成本仍能区分时长产品及其所需价格。运营者应比较经过资格检验的年度净值，并纳入不参与的选项，而不能仅按每报价千瓦的门槛给服务排序。等待价格与损失估值仍是假设；计算识别的是在这些假设下需要何种补偿，而不是真实运营者一定会接受。

before.en: For an operator, the assessment begins with an inventory of work that is contractually permitted to wait, together with the hardware and deadlines available to complete it. A capacity and call schedule can then be selected and independently tested before local grid benefits and participation costs are assessed. This is consistent with capacity assessment for other resources whose actions are coupled over time.<sup>28,29</sup> Changing the workload mix requires the downstream calculations to be repeated; a sensitivity curve for planning potential alone cannot establish the reliability or economics of a different operating configuration.
before.zh: 对运营商而言，评估应先盘点合同允许等待的工作，以及完成它所需的硬件和截止时间。随后选择容量与调用安排，进行独立检验，再评估本地电网收益和参与成本。这与其他跨时段相互制约资源的容量评估相一致。<sup>28,29</sup> 工作构成改变之后，必须重做下游计算；单有规划潜力的敏感性曲线，不能证明另一种运行配置的可靠性或经济性。

after.en: For planning, the useful output is a conditional commitment: eligible jobs, deadline standard, installed allocation, capacity and call arrangement, accompanied by delivery evidence and a recalculable cost ledger. This is consistent with capacity assessment for other resources whose actions are coupled over time.<sup>29,30</sup> The matched last-call check also shows why programme failure should not automatically be attributed to cumulative recovery damage. Changes in job timing and service obligations need direct tests, and a candidate should be reduced or withheld when those tests do not support it.
after.zh: 对规划而言，有用的产出是一份附带条件的承诺：允许参与的作业、期限标准、已有硬件分配、容量与调用安排，并同时提供交付证据及可重新计价的账本。这与其他行动跨时段耦合资源的容量评估相一致。<sup>29,30</sup> 最后一次调用的配对核对也说明，不能自动将整组调用失败归因于恢复造成的累积损害。工作时序与服务义务变化需要直接检验；检验不支持时，应降低或暂不采用该候选承诺。

before.en: These numerical results remain conditional model evidence. Requested GPU-hours from one production infrastructure are not energy measurements or an industry workload census. Deferral permission and deadlines were assumed; hourly divisible jobs, constant rigid demand and a small board-power calibration do not reproduce online latency, checkpoint overhead or facility response. The 40% and 60% cases add unverified participation and business-composition assumptions. Recovery interventions were developed after inspecting earlier failures and then tested on fresh scenarios. The four-call programmes span only four declared schedules; annual costs sample independent series rather than a continuous year. Actual GPU procurement, ageing and contractual failure penalties require operator data. These limitations constrain numerical transfer while leaving the comparisons reproducible.
before.zh: 这些数值结果仍是以模型假设为条件的证据。单一生产设施中的请求 GPU 小时并非实测电能，也不代表行业工作构成普查。延期权限和期限由情景设定；按小时可分割的作业、恒定刚性需求与小规模板卡功率标定不能复现在线时延、检查点开销或设施响应。40% 和 60% 情景增加了未经验证的参与和业务构成假设。恢复干预是在检查既有失败后开发的，随后才在新情景上检验。四次调用仅覆盖四种明确安排；年度成本抽样独立序列，并非连续全年运行。实际 GPU 采购、老化和合同违约罚款需要运营者数据。这些限制约束了数值外推，但各项比较仍可复现。

after.en: The evidence remains conditional on hourly divisible jobs, synthetic deadlines and permissions, a constant rigid-load proxy and a small board-power calibration. The five eligibility scenarios share template scaling; the structural controls and eight observed timing weeks broaden this evidence without making it an industry workload census. The timing transfer preserves submission counts, not actual runtimes, job dependencies or production service agreements. No application pause–checkpoint–restart sequence was measured. Selection and confirmation were separated, but all probability bounds are pointwise and all capacities belong to finite candidate grids. Four-call episodes and independent annual draws do not establish continuous-year performance. These boundaries limit numerical transfer and any claim of universal superiority over existing approaches.
after.zh: 证据仍以按小时划分的可分工作、合成期限和参与许可、恒定刚性负荷代理及小规模板卡功率校准为条件。五档参与比例情景共用模板缩放；结构对照和八个真实时序周拓宽了证据，但不使其成为行业工作负荷普查。时序迁移保留提交计数，不保留真实运行时长、作业依赖或生产服务协议。我们没有测量应用的暂停—检查点—恢复过程。候选选择与确认虽然分离，但所有概率界均为逐点界，所有容量均来自有限候选网格。四次调用阶段与独立年度抽样不能证明全年连续表现。这些边界限制了数值外推，也限制了相对现有方法普遍占优的主张。

before.en: The recovery-mechanism extension reused development seeds 930000–930099 after examining the preceding results; its design is therefore an informed follow-up. Controller, criteria and candidate grid were frozen before 300 new confirmation seeds (970000–970299) were run. Selection was then frozen before controlled confirmation. The extension contains 10,100 development and 13,800 confirmation replays across five workload configurations. These runs share scenario seeds across methods and requests; they do not increase the number of independent samples per condition.
before.zh: 恢复机制扩展是在检查前述结果后，复用开发种子 930000–930099 开展的，因此属于已有证据指导的后续研究。控制器、标准和候选网格在运行 300 个新确认种子（970000–970299）前冻结；选值结果又在受控确认运行前冻结。扩展包含五档工作配置下的 10,100 次开发回放与 13,800 次确认回放。不同方法和请求共享情景种子，这些回放不会增加每种条件的独立样本数。

before.en: Success further required a deadline-miss fraction no greater than 0.01, a rebound ratio no greater than 0.25, an event-plus-recovery peak-relief fraction of at least 0.50 and terminal backlog no greater than 0.02 of offered work. Rebound was the maximum positive controlled-minus-baseline PCC load in the 24-h recovery window, divided by peak event reduction. Mean and minimum interval delivery were reported separately. All criteria were fixed in the protocol; average delivered energy could not compensate for a failed hourly requirement.
before.zh: 成功还要求：超期工作比例不超过 0.01，反弹比不超过 0.25，事件及恢复窗口的峰值缓解比例至少为 0.50，终端积压不超过所提交工作量的 0.02。反弹定义为 24 h 恢复窗口内受控公共连接点负荷相对基线的最大正增量，除以事件期间的峰值削减量。平均交付和最小区间交付分别报告。全部标准均预先固定在协议中；平均交付电量不能补偿某个小时要求未达标。

after.en: Success further required a deadline-miss fraction of eligible work no greater than 0.01, a rebound ratio no greater than 0.25, an event-plus-recovery peak-relief fraction of at least 0.50 and terminal backlog no greater than 0.02 of offered work. Rebound was the maximum positive controlled-minus-baseline PCC load in the 24-h recovery window, divided by peak event reduction. Mean and minimum interval delivery were reported separately. All criteria were fixed in the protocol; average delivered energy could not compensate for a failed hourly requirement.
after.zh: 成功还要求：超期工作比例不超过 0.01，反弹比不超过 0.25，事件及恢复窗口的峰值缓解比例至少为 0.50，终端积压不超过所提交工作量的 0.02。反弹定义为 24 h 恢复窗口内受控公共连接点负荷相对基线的最大正增量，除以事件期间的峰值削减量。平均交付和最小区间交付分别报告。全部标准均预先固定在协议中；平均交付电量不能补偿某个小时要求未达标。 期限违约率的分母为到达的可参与工作 GPU 小时量。

after.en: The structural study additionally required zero total missed eligible work, allowing only 10<sup>−7</sup> GPU-h for numerical round-off. Both response and no-response trajectories had to satisfy that zero criterion; all electrical and terminal-backlog thresholds were unchanged. The 0.1% allowance was a secondary reported endpoint without offer selection. Baseline failures remained failures rather than exclusions. Earlier selected offers were also rescored at zero loss, explicitly as a retrospective check.
after.zh: 结构研究还检验了全部可参与工作的总期限违约量为零的要求，仅允许 10<sup>−7</sup> GPU-h 的数值舍入容差。响应与无响应轨迹都必须满足该零违约标准；电力与期末积压门槛保持不变。0.1% 容忍度作为次要报告终点，不用于选择报价。基线不合格计为失败，不予剔除。此前选出的报价也进行了零损失重评分，并明确标为回顾性核对。

before.en: ### Repeated-event comparison
before.zh: ### 连续事件比较

after.en: ### Repeated commitments and structural controls
after.zh: ### 重复承诺与结构对照

before.en: Repeated programmes comprised four four-hour calls with eight-hour gaps, or four eight-hour calls with twelve-hour gaps, starting at hour 63. For each workload configuration, development tested 25%, 50%, 75% and 100% of its selected single-event offer. The rule selected the largest qualifying candidate, if any, for independent confirmation. Regardless of that selection outcome, the original single-event offer was prespecified as a repeated-programme comparator and independently tested. The two programmes do not exhaust possible dispatch schedules.
before.zh: 重复方案由四次四小时调用、间隔八小时，或四次八小时调用、间隔十二小时组成，首次均从第 63 小时开始。各配置在开发阶段检验已选单次承诺的 25%、50%、75%、100%；若有候选通过，则选择最大者独立确认。无论该选值结果如何，原单次承诺均被预设为重复方案的对照并接受独立检验。这两个方案未穷尽所有调度安排。

after.en: All new structural tests used the corrected MPC wrapper, which retains a separate ceiling for each observed event-and-recovery window and clips the proposal to the strictest live ceiling. It uses elapsed baseline peaks and current observations, without future jobs or unannounced calls. Earlier comparisons with the original implementation and guarded greedy policy are retained in Supplementary Methods 6. New candidates were 25%, 50%, 75% and 100% of the fixed 5.898243186-kW reference request. Selection was separate for the 1% and zero-miss endpoints and preceded independent confirmation; successful unselected comparators were not promoted.
after.zh: 全部新增结构检验使用修正后的 MPC 包装器：为每个已观测的事件及恢复窗口保留独立上限，并按当前最严格的上限截断建议动作。它仅使用已发生的基线峰值与当前观测，不读取未来作业或未通知的调用。原实现及加入相同保护的贪心策略比较保留在补充方法 6。新候选为固定参考请求 5.898243186 kW 的 25%、50%、75% 和 100%。1% 与零违约终点分别选择候选，随后独立确认；未被选中的对照即使确认成功，也不追认为已选报价。

after.en: At fixed 10% work eligibility and 576 GPUs, offered utilisation was total work divided by installed GPU-hours, set to 50%, 65% or 80%. Deadline slack was unchanged or halved with a one-hour floor; flexible GPU allocation was 10%, with 20% controls at 65% and 80% utilisation under tight deadlines. The final event started at hour 111 plus a seeded uniform integer from 0 to 23; preceding starts were spaced backwards by 16 or 24 h. All eight variants tested eight-hour calls, and the reference also tested four-hour calls at 16-h spacing. A fresh eight-hour final call at the same time removed the preceding calls. All recovery windows ended during 168 h of arrivals, followed by a 48-h clearance tail. Development seeds 984000–984099 and confirmation seeds 985000–985299 supplied 7,600 and 13,200 complete replays, respectively. Two pilot seeds were excluded.
after.zh: 固定 10% 工作可参与和 576 个 GPU 后，将工作供给利用率定义为总工作量除以已安装 GPU 小时数，设为 50%、65% 或 80%。期限余量保持参考值或减半，下限为一小时；灵活 GPU 分配为 10%，并在 65% 和 80% 利用率的紧期限情景中增加 20% 分配对照。最后一次事件从第 111 小时加一个由种子确定、在 0–23 间均匀抽取的整数开始；此前事件依次向前相隔 16 或 24 h。八个变体均检验八小时调用，参考条件还检验 16 h 开始间隔的四小时调用。相同时刻的孤立八小时末次调用移除前三次事件。所有恢复窗口均在 168 h 到达阶段内结束，随后有 48 h 清空尾段。开发种子 984000–984099 与确认种子 985000–985299 分别产生 7,600 和 13,200 次完整重放；两个试运行种子不纳入分析。

after.en: For the external timing stress test, hourly submission counts from the Alibaba 2020 GPU trace<sup>32</sup> supplied eight consecutive 168-h blocks. Counts set the hourly weights of synthetic class-specific work, preserving each class total and reference deadlines. The paired alternative permuted complete hourly blocks within the same week. Ten synthetic realisations per week crossed both orderings and 10%/20% GPU allocations with five frozen programme–request combinations, giving 1,600 replays without retuning. Results are reported by observed week and descriptively across 80 realisations per condition; they are not 80 independent production weeks.
after.zh: 外部时序压力检验采用 Alibaba 2020 GPU 轨迹的每小时提交计数，<sup>32</sup> 提供连续八个 168 h 区块。计数决定各类别合成工作的逐小时权重，同时保留各类总工作量与参考期限。配对替代条件在同一周内置乱完整小时块。每周十次合成实现，交叉两种顺序、10%/20% GPU 分配与五个冻结的“方案—请求”组合，共 1,600 次重放，不重新调参。结果按真实周报告，并对每条件 80 次实现作描述性汇总；它们不等于 80 个独立生产周。

before.en: Matched fresh counterfactuals removed all other calls while preserving the same seed, jobs, community trajectory and clock time. Both the repeated programme and the combination of fresh runs required all four calls to pass. Paired success differences resampled 300 complete scenario seeds 10,000 times. Each complete controlled trajectory was paired with its own no-response baseline for queue, service and economic calculations. Earlier ten-schedule, production-timing and horizon interventions remain separately labelled historical analyses in the archived v0.19 Supplementary Information.
before.zh: 配对的新事件反事实删除其余调用，同时保持种子、作业、社区轨迹和时刻相同。重复方案与新事件运行的组合都要求四次全部通过。成功率的配对差异对 300 个完整情景种子重采样 10,000 次。每条完整受控轨迹均与自身的无响应基准配对，用于队列、服务和经济核算。此前十种调用安排、生产时序及运行期干预在归档的 v0.19 补充材料中单独标明为历史分析。

before.en: The mechanism extension compared the unchanged controller with a wrapper preserving a separate ceiling for every currently observed event-and-recovery window. The wrapper learned calls from current observations and retained only elapsed baseline peaks; it did not inspect future calls or arrivals. It clipped the same MPC action to the strictest live ceiling and retained feasible-side rounding. A greedy full-allocation proposal under the same wrapper provided a diagnostic at 10% eligibility. Four-call programmes used (H,G) = (4,8), (8,8), (8,12) and (8,16) hours. Every final 24-h recovery ended within the 168-h arrival period. Four-hour development tested the original request; eight-hour development tested 50%, 75% and 100%. The largest candidate passing the one-sided Wilson lower-bound threshold of 0.95 was selected. Confirmation tested that candidate, or the prespecified full-request comparator when none qualified. Full-request comparisons for both MPC versions at (8,12), and the greedy diagnostic, were retained regardless of selection. Confirmation never selected a replacement.
before.zh: 机制扩展将未改变的原控制器与一个控制包装器比较；后者为当前已观察到的每个事件及恢复窗口分别保留功率上限。包装器通过当前观测获知调用，只保存已经发生的基准峰值，不读取未来调用或未来到达。它将同一个 MPC 动作限制在所有存续窗口中最严格的上限内，并保留向可行侧舍入。在 10% 工作资格下，另将同一包装器用于始终提议全额分配的贪心策略，作为诊断。四次调用采用 (H,G) = (4,8)、(8,8)、(8,12) 和 (8,16) 小时。各安排最后一次调用的完整 24 小时恢复均在 168 小时到达期内结束。四小时开发检验原请求，八小时开发检验原请求的 50%、75% 和 100%，选择单侧 Wilson 下界达到 0.95 的最大候选。确认检验该候选；若没有候选合格，则检验预先声明的全额请求比较方案。两种 MPC 在 (8,12) 安排下的全额比较及贪心诊断不论选值结果如何均予保留。确认集不用于挑选替代承诺。

after.en: The fee decomposition used common annual draws and the same linear-interpolation weights at the total net-cost 95th percentile for every component; it did not add marginal component quantiles. Additional screens crossed site fees US$0, 1,000, 2,500, 5,000, 10,000 and 25,000, waiting prices US$0, 0.005 and 0.01 per GPU-h/h, and missed-work prices US$0 and 1 per GPU-h. Sharing a US$25,000 fee among ten or five resources gave US$2,500 or 5,000 without a diversification benefit. For qualified product j with accounting capacity K_j and annual net operating cost O_j at its 95th percentile, the fifth-percentile net value was P_j K_j − O_j − F. Duration-price boundaries compared these values and the zero value of not participating. They are algebraic consequences of the stated ledgers and prices, not estimated market tariffs.
after.zh: 费用分解采用共同年度抽样，对每一成本项使用总净成本第 95 百分位对应的相同线性插值权重，不能相加各项自身的边际分位数。新增筛选交叉场站费用 0、1,000、2,500、5,000、10,000 和 25,000 美元，等待价格每 GPU-h 每小时 0、0.005 和 0.01 美元，以及每 GPU-h 期限违约工作价格 0 和 1 美元。25,000 美元由十个或五个资源分摊，分别为 2,500 或 5,000 美元，不附加分散风险收益。对合格产品 j，若核算容量为 K_j、年度净运行成本第 95 百分位为 O_j，其净值第五百分位为 P_j K_j − O_j − F。时长价格边界比较这些净值及不参与的零净值。它们是指定账本与价格的代数结果，不是估计的市场价格。

after.en: Structural contrasts resampled 300 complete paired scenario seeds 5,000 times. Exact McNemar tests were Holm-adjusted over the 36 binary structural contrasts; the 16 additional matched-target electrical contrasts formed a separate family. The zero-loss and 1% offer tests each retained the pointwise one-sided 95% Wilson lower-bound criterion of 0.95. Multiple successful selections do not create a simultaneous confidence guarantee. Submission-order comparisons retained the observed week as the external sampling unit and were not assigned binomial certificates from pooled synthetic realisations.
after.zh: 结构对照对 300 个完整配对情景种子进行 5,000 次重抽样。精确 McNemar 检验在 36 个二元结构对照之间使用 Holm 校正；额外 16 个末次调用电力对照构成单独的检验族。零损失与 1% 报价检验均保留逐点单侧 95% Wilson 概率下界不低于 0.95 的规则。多个选择成功不构成同时置信保证。提交顺序比较保留真实周作为外部抽样单位，不把合并的合成实现赋予二项资格证明。

before.en: The new controller comparison paired complete four-call scenario seeds. Its primary contrast was the full request at 10% eligibility with eight-hour calls and twelve-hour gaps. Paired bootstrap intervals used 10,000 whole-seed resamples; exact McNemar tests were Holm-adjusted across all reported controller contrasts. Failure families were non-exclusive. Offer qualification remained pointwise; passing multiple conditions does not provide simultaneous 95% confidence. New repeated-cost screens used the same complete-series accounting and 2,000 annual draws, crossing waiting prices 0, 0.005 and 0.01, site costs US$10,000, 25,000 and 50,000 and displaced values US$0, 0.25 and 0.50 per deferred GPU-h.
before.zh: 新控制器比较以完整四调用情景种子配对。主要比较为 10% 工作资格、八小时调用和十二小时间隔下的全额请求。配对 bootstrap 区间采用 10,000 次完整种子重采样；精确 McNemar 检验对全部报告的控制器比较进行 Holm 校正。各失败类别可以重叠。承诺资格仍按逐项标准检验，多项通过不意味着具有同时 95% 置信保证。新的重复调用成本分析使用相同的完整序列核算和 2,000 次年度抽样，将等待价格 0、0.005、0.01，固定场地成本 10,000、25,000、50,000 美元，以及每延后 GPU 小时 0、0.25、0.50 美元的被挤出工作价值交叉组合。

before.en: **a,** Full single-event requests reused for four eight-hour calls with twelve-hour gaps. Points show original MPC and MPC with per-call recovery on 300 new paired complete scenarios per workload configuration; whiskers are one-sided 95% Wilson lower limits. **b,** The lowest development seed for which the original programme failed and per-call recovery passed at 10% eligibility (seed 930012). before.zh: **a，** 将单次事件全额请求用于四次八小时调用、十二小时间隔。点表示各工作配置下原 MPC 与逐次保留恢复约束的 MPC 在 300 个新配对完整情景中的成功率；误差线为单侧 95% Wilson 下界。**b，** 10% 工作资格下，原安排失败而逐次恢复约束方案成功的最小开发种子（930012）。局部图将恢复峰值相对于所示调用的事件及恢复期基准峰值表示；虚线功率上限要求至少削减请求的一半。这个按规则选择的开发示例用于解释机制，不能估计出现频率。**c，** 10% 工作资格下，按调用时长和间隔列出开发选出的承诺；如独立确认失败，则标叉。“未选出”表示测试网格中的选值结果，不代表物理容量为零。四次调用均须满足全部未改变的电力和服务标准。完整选值和失败计数见补充表 10、11。

after.en: **a,** Development-selected, independently confirmed eight-hour offers at 16-h start spacing, under 1% or zero total missed work. Utilisation denotes offered GPU-hours divided by installed capacity; tight deadlines halve reference slack. NS means no candidate selected, not zero physical capacity. **b,** At the prespecified 5.90-kW request, non-exclusive counts of scenarios with insufficient instantaneous eligible power to satisfy 95% interval delivery, or more than 1% missed work. This supply test is necessary, not sufficient. Panels a,b use 300 independent confirmation scenarios per condition and corrected recovery control. **c,** Success counts within each of eight observed production weeks, with ten synthetic realisations per week, chronological or permuted hourly submission weights and 10% GPU allocation. All panels retain 10% work eligibility and four calls; eight-hour/16-h means eight-hour gaps. Full selections, bounds and timing controls are in Supplementary Tables 14–16.

after.en: The new structural test begins after that repair. Tightened deadlines and low instantaneous eligible power are separate failure mechanisms; a scenario may fail both. Zero total missed work is a stricter endpoint than a 1% allowance and receives its own development selection. In every new same-clock final-call contrast, the electrical outcome was identical with or without preceding calls. This prevents attributing all programme failure to damaged recovery. Chronological and permuted production submissions change temporal structure without changing class totals; neither ordering is asserted to be universally harder.
after.zh: 新结构检验从修复完成后开始。紧期限与瞬时可参与功率不足是不同的失败机制，同一情景可以同时出现。总期限违约工作为零比 1% 容忍度更严格，需要单独在开发集选择。所有新增相同时刻末次调用对照中，有无先前调用的电力结果均相同，因此不能把全部方案失败归因于恢复受损。生产提交的原序与置乱改变时间结构而不改变类别总量；不能宣称其中一种顺序普遍更难。

after.en: The new decomposition confirms that approximately 95% of the reference single-event threshold is a fixed-site allocation. Operating components are attributed at the rank of total net cost so that they add back exactly. A shared fee changes the value relative to opting out, but a common fee cancels between two participating products. Product choice must compare annual net values at stated duration-specific prices, with only independently qualified choices eligible. The figures retain zero/low fees and operating costs separately to expose these different decisions.
after.zh: 新增分解确认，参考单次事件门槛约 95% 是固定场站分摊。运行项在总净成本的排序位置上归因，确保相加后准确还原总数。共享费用改变相对不参与的价值，而两个参与产品共同承担的费用在相互比较时抵消。产品选择必须在指定的分时长价格下比较年度净值，并只允许独立合格的选择参与。图中分别保留零/低费用与运行成本，以区分这些决策。

after.en: The structural study additionally required zero total missed eligible work, allowing only 10<sup>−7</sup> GPU-h for numerical round-off. Both response and no-response trajectories had to satisfy that zero criterion; all electrical and terminal-backlog thresholds were unchanged. The 0.1% allowance was a secondary reported endpoint without offer selection. Baseline failures remained failures rather than exclusions. Earlier selected offers were also rescored at zero loss, explicitly as a retrospective check.
after.zh: 结构研究还检验了全部可参与工作的总期限违约量为零的要求，仅允许 10<sup>−7</sup> GPU-h 的数值舍入容差。响应与无响应轨迹都必须满足该零违约标准；电力与期末积压门槛保持不变。0.1% 容忍度作为次要报告终点，不用于选择报价。基线不合格计为失败，不予剔除。此前选出的报价也进行了零损失重评分，并明确标为回顾性核对。

after.en: At fixed 10% work eligibility and 576 GPUs, offered utilisation was total work divided by installed GPU-hours, set to 50%, 65% or 80%. Deadline slack was unchanged or halved with a one-hour floor; flexible GPU allocation was 10%, with 20% controls at 65% and 80% utilisation under tight deadlines. The final event started at hour 111 plus a seeded uniform integer from 0 to 23; preceding starts were spaced backwards by 16 or 24 h. All eight variants tested eight-hour calls, and the reference also tested four-hour calls at 16-h spacing. A fresh eight-hour final call at the same time removed the preceding calls. All recovery windows ended during 168 h of arrivals, followed by a 48-h clearance tail. Development seeds 984000–984099 and confirmation seeds 985000–985299 supplied 7,600 and 13,200 complete replays, respectively. Two pilot seeds were excluded.
after.zh: 固定 10% 工作可参与和 576 个 GPU 后，将工作供给利用率定义为总工作量除以已安装 GPU 小时数，设为 50%、65% 或 80%。期限余量保持参考值或减半，下限为一小时；灵活 GPU 分配为 10%，并在 65% 和 80% 利用率的紧期限情景中增加 20% 分配对照。最后一次事件从第 111 小时加一个由种子确定、在 0–23 间均匀抽取的整数开始；此前事件依次向前相隔 16 或 24 h。八个变体均检验八小时调用，参考条件还检验 16 h 开始间隔的四小时调用。相同时刻的孤立八小时末次调用移除前三次事件。所有恢复窗口均在 168 h 到达阶段内结束，随后有 48 h 清空尾段。开发种子 984000–984099 与确认种子 985000–985299 分别产生 7,600 和 13,200 次完整重放；两个试运行种子不纳入分析。

after.en: For the external timing stress test, hourly submission counts from the Alibaba 2020 GPU trace<sup>32</sup> supplied eight consecutive 168-h blocks. Counts set the hourly weights of synthetic class-specific work, preserving each class total and reference deadlines. The paired alternative permuted complete hourly blocks within the same week. Ten synthetic realisations per week crossed both orderings and 10%/20% GPU allocations with five frozen programme–request combinations, giving 1,600 replays without retuning. Results are reported by observed week and descriptively across 80 realisations per condition; they are not 80 independent production weeks.
after.zh: 外部时序压力检验采用 Alibaba 2020 GPU 轨迹的每小时提交计数，<sup>32</sup> 提供连续八个 168 h 区块。计数决定各类别合成工作的逐小时权重，同时保留各类总工作量与参考期限。配对替代条件在同一周内置乱完整小时块。每周十次合成实现，交叉两种顺序、10%/20% GPU 分配与五个冻结的“方案—请求”组合，共 1,600 次重放，不重新调参。结果按真实周报告，并对每条件 80 次实现作描述性汇总；它们不等于 80 个独立生产周。

after.en: Structural contrasts resampled 300 complete paired scenario seeds 5,000 times. Exact McNemar tests were Holm-adjusted over the 36 binary structural contrasts; the 16 additional matched-target electrical contrasts formed a separate family. The zero-loss and 1% offer tests each retained the pointwise one-sided 95% Wilson lower-bound criterion of 0.95. Multiple successful selections do not create a simultaneous confidence guarantee. Submission-order comparisons retained the observed week as the external sampling unit and were not assigned binomial certificates from pooled synthetic realisations.
after.zh: 结构对照对 300 个完整配对情景种子进行 5,000 次重抽样。精确 McNemar 检验在 36 个二元结构对照之间使用 Holm 校正；额外 16 个末次调用电力对照构成单独的检验族。零损失与 1% 报价检验均保留逐点单侧 95% Wilson 概率下界不低于 0.95 的规则。多个选择成功不构成同时置信保证。提交顺序比较保留真实周作为外部抽样单位，不把合并的合成实现赋予二项资格证明。

after.en: A necessary supply diagnostic compared each active hour’s matched baseline PCC power minus community load and idle-plus-rigid data-centre power with 0.95 times the request. If the former was smaller, even zero flexible execution could not meet the interval requirement. This lower-envelope test identifies immediate shortage but does not prove feasibility when passed. Deadline and terminal criteria were scored over the whole 216-h episode. Last-call electrical scoring excluded those global service quantities, matched the final clock exactly and used the fresh run’s reindexed event 0. All 16 paired differences were zero. Programme-wide criteria were not substituted for local electrical outcomes.
after.zh: 必要供给诊断逐一比较事件小时中“匹配基线 PCC 功率减去社区负荷及数据中心空闲加刚性功率”与请求的 0.95 倍。前者较小时，即使灵活工作执行量为零，也无法满足逐时交付要求。该下包络检验识别即时不足，通过时并不证明可行。期限及期末标准按完整 216 h 运行阶段评分。末次调用的电力评分排除这些全局服务量，严格对齐末次时刻，并使用孤立运行重新编号后的事件 0。全部 16 个配对差值均为零，不能用整个方案的判定替代局部电力结果。

after.en: The timing input was the processed Alibaba 2020 job-submission table (714,903 GPU jobs), using trace hours 168–1511 inclusive. The eight 168-h weeks supplied hourly counts; each week’s class-specific synthetic total was normalised to the unchanged offered work. A whole-hour permutation preserved the marginal hourly volumes and the exact class–deadline totals. Seeds 986000 + 100w + r, for week w = 0,…,7 and realisation r = 0,…,9, generated paired inputs. Frozen tests used request fractions 0.5, 0.75 and 1 at eight-hour/16-h spacing, and 0.5 and 1 at eight-hour/24-h spacing. No external result selected a new fraction. Submission counts preserve one observed temporal feature; they do not supply real GPU-hour volumes, deadlines or job dependencies. All 320 timing input variants passed the baseline service gate.
after.zh: 时序输入为处理后的 Alibaba 2020 作业提交表，共 714,903 个 GPU 作业，使用轨迹第 168–1511 小时（含端点）。八个 168 h 周提供逐小时计数，各周各类合成总量归一至不变的供给工作量。完整小时置乱保留小时量的边际分布及精确的“类别—期限”总量。种子为 986000 + 100w + r，其中周 w = 0,…,7、实现 r = 0,…,9，生成配对输入。冻结检验在八小时/16 h 开始间隔采用请求比例 0.5、0.75、1，在八小时/24 h 采用 0.5、1。没有根据外部结果选择新比例。提交计数保留了一种真实时间特征，不提供真实 GPU 小时量、期限或作业依赖。全部 320 个时序输入变体通过基线服务门槛。

after.en: The fee decomposition used common annual draws and the same linear-interpolation weights at the total net-cost 95th percentile for every component; it did not add marginal component quantiles. Additional screens crossed site fees US$0, 1,000, 2,500, 5,000, 10,000 and 25,000, waiting prices US$0, 0.005 and 0.01 per GPU-h/h, and missed-work prices US$0 and 1 per GPU-h. Sharing a US$25,000 fee among ten or five resources gave US$2,500 or 5,000 without a diversification benefit. For qualified product j with accounting capacity K_j and annual net operating cost O_j at its 95th percentile, the fifth-percentile net value was P_j K_j − O_j − F. Duration-price boundaries compared these values and the zero value of not participating. They are algebraic consequences of the stated ledgers and prices, not estimated market tariffs.
